description: Ahmed body, 25 degree slant, no stilts, full model (no symmetry plane), fixed ground
physics: steady RANS, k-omega SST, segregated, incompressible

reference.frontal_area_note: A/L^2, nondimensional; the dimensional area is frontal_area times length_L_m squared

convergence.limit_cycle_diff_note: fraction of pixels changing between frames 10 iterations apart; frames cropped of the title band, resized to 1024 px, then differenced with a 1 percent threshold, so the number describes the image shipped in views/; early window (03000 vs 03010) gives 0.121 percent, so the cycle is stationary rather than decaying

quality_checks.qc_cpillar_asym_criterion: PASS if below 5e-2; value always reported
quality_checks.cd_component_closure: cd_pressure + cd_friction = 0.3218340, matches cd_total to 7 decimals

caveats.cd_vs_experiment: experimental cd for this configuration is about 0.285; the present RANS SST result is about 13 percent high, consistent with known over-separation of the 25 degree slant in steady RANS
caveats.cl_band: cl_total drifts within about 3e-4 due to the limit cycle; the fourth digit is not meaningful
caveats.yplus_floor_max_location: the floor maximum of 4.03 occurs at the domain corner (x = -1.9875, y = 1.4375), far from the body; the near-body floor stays well below it, see views/view_floor_footprint.png
caveats.run_provenance: this run was executed on a workstation rather than the cluster; all scalars reproduce the cluster run within the declared bands, differences appear only in the fourth digit and reflect limit cycle phase
